stages.headline: A convex polyhedron is regular if all faces are equal regular polygons and the same number of edges meet at every vertex; there are only 5 of them.
stages.headlineEnglish: A convex polyhedron is regular if all faces are equal regular polygons and the same number of edges meet at every vertex; there are only 5 of them.

stages.headline: Why only 5? The face angles at a vertex must add to less than 360°; three hexagons give 3 · 120° = 360°, which is flat.
stages.headlineEnglish: Why only 5? The face angles at a vertex must add to less than 360°; three hexagons give 3 · 120° = 360°, which is flat.

stages.headline: The octahedron is made of 8 equilateral triangles, four meeting at each vertex.
stages.headlineEnglish: The octahedron is made of 8 equilateral triangles, four meeting at each vertex.
